rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Permanent Removal, Temporary Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation amounts set by the date of service of the eviction notice. For notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 this is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; maximum $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren) (notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation; amount depends on date of service of the notice of termination of tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction_text: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation payments set by the date of service of the eviction notice. For notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 this is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
